summary: A mixed day driven by Reliance's landmark Jio IPO roadshow and legal disruptions in Delhi, with market volatility amid economic headwinds. Stock market recovery offset by concerns over slowing global growth and judicial protests impacting operations.

bullets.text: Jio Platforms IPO roadshow underway; Ambani heirs facing investor scrutiny on record offering valuation and strategy.
Delhi CJP protests: Rouse Avenue and Patiala House courts to function virtually tomorrow; 57 metro stations shut.
GQG Partners entities sold 50.39 lakh Adani Power shares, reducing stake to 5.72% from 5.74% through on-market transactions.
Global economic growth projected to slow to 2.6% in 2026 amid energy shocks from Middle East crisis, UN trade body warns.
Diageo India launches ready-to-drink alcohol market entry with Smirnoff Ice, competing directly with Bacardi in nascent segment.
